items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: You got Grabger, you got Pedita and Perdita, that's straight there, the blocks.

ctx.x: Yeah. It's from Claiborne all the way back, but it starts at Grabger. Mm-hmm. You got Grabger, you got Pedita and Perdita, that's straight there, the blocks. Now, I, then it goes all the way back to Broad, that's the battlefield.
